title: Meeting brief
summary: Before each outside meeting, researches the other company and writes a short, cited brief to the Desk.

inspiration.title: Website chatbot with lead capture and Outlook calendar

stages.title: Find outside meetings
stages.does: Lists meetings inside the look-ahead window that include an outside domain.

stages.title: Research each company
stages.does: Searches for each outside company and reads a few pages, keeping each source URL.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Calendar
connectors.purpose: List upcoming meetings and their attendee domains.
connectors.connect: Add a calendar connector with read access to the routine's environment.

connectors.label: Web search
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run already has web search; check it does before the first run.

connectors.label: Web fetch
connectors.connect: Nothing to connect when the run can already open web pages.
